problem: acpi_device_get_prop used the firmware key length for prefix comparison, so a request for sdhci-caps-mask matched an earlier sdhci-caps key.
before: Actual original function reproduces the wrong 0x0120fa81 result for sdhci-caps-mask when only sdhci-caps exists.
after: Require a nonnull firmware string and an exact matching key length before the bounded comparison.

native_combined_kernel.scope: Full original native GENERIC link with two changed objects over the previously built Pi stack; includes separate reservation fix and legacy SD driver. Not native execution or physical acceptance of this independent branch.

CI: Disabled at operator request; local/native testing only
standard_lifecycle: No receipt or per-unit admission claimed

native_model_runtime.model: Pi4 UEFI/ACPI partial BCM2711 model, not physical hardware
native_model_runtime.before: Legacy slot has zero capabilities and no supported voltage because sdhci-caps-mask aliases sdhci-caps. Second slot also fails its separately repaired shared interrupt setup.
native_model_runtime.after: Legacy slot uses firmware capabilities and 250MHz base clock; no missing-clock/voltage/IRQ warnings. Both SD paths separately pass 1MiB write/read and whole-backing checks with GENET DHCP/SSH/bidirectional transfers.
native_model_runtime.limitations: Combined stack includes the separate SD controller, fixed-clock and shareable-IRQ changes. Runtime is a private new-kernel/older-diagnostic-world cohort; no hardware acceptance or release qualification.
